spanish: Cordero perfecto, macho, hijo de año, será a ustedes; de los corderos y de las cabras tomarán.

findings.issue: H7716 (common-gender singular, no article) is rendered Cordero, the same animal as H3532 הַכְּבָשִׂים. That narrows the head noun to a young sheep and closes the openness the distinct lemmas leave, including the goats in H5795.

notes: perfecto, macho, hijo de año, será a ustedes, and tomarán match the remaining tokens, including 2mp ustedes.
